mapper.sql: select r.request_no, r.member_id, r.warehouse_no, r.goods_no, r.qty, r.request_type, r.status, r.memo, r.request_date, r.process_date, r.process_member_id, g.goods_code, g.goods_name, w.warehouse_name, nvl(s.stock_qty, 0) as stock_qty from tb_stock_request r join tb_goods g on r.goods_no = g.goods_no join tb_warehouse w on r.warehouse_no = w.warehouse_no left join tb_warehouse_stock s on s.warehouse_no = r.warehouse_no and s.goods_no = r.goods_no
mapper.select: where r.member_id = #{memberId} order by r.request_no desc
select count(*) from tb_stock_request where status = 'WAIT'
mapper.insert:
select seq_request.nextval from dual
insert into tb_stock_request ( request_no, member_id, warehouse_no, goods_no, qty, request_type, status, memo, request_date ) values ( #{requestNo}, #{memberId}, #{warehouseNo}, #{goodsNo}, #{qty}, #{requestType}, #{status}, #{memo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sysdate )
